prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach, take, analyze and deliver. Else, scan area for object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = DeliverObject    /> <SubTree ID = AnalyzeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachObject    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <SubTree ID = AnalyzeObject    />     <Action ID = DeliverObject    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />         <Action ID = ApproachObject    />         <Action ID = TakeObject    />         <SubTree ID = AnalyzeObject    />         <Action ID = DeliverObject    />     </Sequence>     <Sequence>                     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />         <Action ID = GrabObject    />         <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> </Fallback>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
				DO ApproachObject
		ELSE
			DO TakeObject
			DO AnalyzeObject
			DO DeliverObject
		END
		DO ScanAreaForObject
	END
